# basemapper

> Headless spatial basemap renderer for Python

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Core rendering
> Low-level tile fetch and composite.

- [render_basemap_raw](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/render_basemap_raw.html): Fetch and composite map tiles into a raw RGBA pixel buffer

#### Plot integrations
> Drop a basemap layer into an existing spatial plot. `geom_basemap` works in both ggplot2 (R) and plotnine (Python).


- [add_basemap](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/add_basemap.html): Render a basemap and composite it beneath existing axes content
- [geom_basemap](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/geom_basemap.html): Render a styled basemap beneath plotnine spatial layers

#### Layer utilities
> Inspect and filter layers inside a MapLibre GL style.

- [list_layers](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/list_layers.html): Return all layer IDs from a MapLibre GL style

#### Tile style helpers
> Convert bare tile URLs to MapLibre GL Style JSON.

- [RasterProvider](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/RasterProvider.html): Generate a MapLibre GL Style JSON string for an XYZ raster tile source
- [VectorProvider](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/VectorProvider.html): Generate a MapLibre GL Style JSON string for an MVT vector tile source
- [EsriVectorProvider](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/EsriVectorProvider.html): Return the root.json style endpoint URL for an ArcGIS VectorTileServer
- [EsriRasterProvider](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/EsriRasterProvider.html): Generate a MapLibre GL Style JSON string for an ArcGIS MapServer raster source

#### Exceptions

- [BasemapError](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/BasemapError.html): Raised when the Rust basemapper core returns an error
